title: Wheel and Tire and Crash Recovery, Part 1
description: B-roll of an interview with Staff Sgt. Robin Simmons discussing her job as a transient alert technician and views of an military aircraft taxing down a runway. Produced by Senior Airman Aaron Mark Johnson

transcript.text: So I'm really enjoying everything I'm learning and getting to see what they're really doing.
Today you're going to watch us do part of our job which is to do follow me procedures for all the transit aircraft that come on a lot, mostly heavies and cargo.
We also facilitate any maintenance needs for all the air crews that do come out here whether it be fuel, if they need any kind of power equipment or air stairs or things of that nature.
I really love it. I came in to be a crew chief which is my day job and this is just another facet of that and all the different people that I get to work with.
It helps make sure we can get the cargo where it needs to go when it needs to get in a timely manner making sure that it's in the world.
We're in Russia and we're getting to learn different parts of the world and how all of our missions are done.
